villain.name: Max Vathen
villain.known: A billionaire has bought an island nation and is building something on it.
villain.forces: Private security, a fleet, more money than several states.

parts.label: The Domination Game
parts.text: They want the lot: a company, a country, a world - whatever the scope of their world is.

parts.label: Organized Crime
parts.text: A coordinated effort to profit outside the law - like a company, but clandestine.

parts.label: Groveler
parts.text: Defined by their subservience - the one who agrees with everything.

parts.label: Hired Hand
parts.text: They work for the villain because they are paid to. Mercenaries, not believers.

parts.label: Specialist
parts.text: Extremely good at one thing, which is the thing they are here for.

parts.label: A Promise Made
parts.text: They serve because something was promised: payment, a reward, something personal.

parts.label: Fight Club
parts.text: Whatever else they are for, what they want is to fight the player character.

parts.label: On A Mission
parts.text: One specific important job, handed down: plant the thing, deliver the thing, be somewhere at a time.
